Vile, Wicked | specialgallery = necromancer Ragged Scar Pattern }} '''Necromancer Ragged Scar Pattern''' is a face scar pattern art introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. It is also available in Prophecies as part of the [[Necromancer Ascalon armor|Initiate's set]] (Necromancer starter armor) or traded from [[collectors]]. Below maximum [[armor rating]] in Prophecies, it is crafted with an optional [[attribute bonus]], all Necromancer attributes except [[Soul Reaping]] are available. At maximum armor rating it can be crafted with any of the Necromancer attributes. '''Necromancer Devilish Scar Pattern''' is a name variant available from armorers in the Prophecies campaign. Below maximum armor rating it is crafted with a Soul Reaping attribute bonus.
